name: LiveX Slack investigation summaries
description: Render validated LiveX Debugger alert summaries in Slack threads.

allowedChannelId.description: Slack channel ID or * for all channels where the priority buttons work. Same semantics as livex-gcp-readonly. Buttons need both this and allowedSenderId.

allowedSenderId.description: Slack user ID allowed to press the priority buttons. Same semantics as livex-gcp-readonly. An unresolved placeholder leaves the cards without buttons.
